claim: Patchline ships an impact citation graph tying adoption and citations to the DOI-pinned artifact. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the citation graph claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make impact-citation-graph-gate`.
